summary: Prebuilt macOS binary opens remote PTY control channel and modifies shell init files
details: @ccfly/setup-darwin-x64 ships a prebuilt Mach-O (x86_64) binary built from github.com/ccfly/rescue/cmd/setup that links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/gorilla/websocket. The binary contains hardcoded ws://ccfly and wss:// destinations plus a polling URL of the form %s/rescue/status?session=%s&agent=%s, wiring a WebSocket client to a spawned PTY on the installer's macOS host — bytes from the remote server are fed into a local shell, providing full interactive RCE on the installer. The same binary contains string literals for.bashrc,.zshrc,.bash_profile, latest.zshrc.ccfly, CCFLY_NO_OPEN, ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS, anthropic.com, and https://registry.npmjs.org, indicating shell-init file modification for persistence/PATH and npm-registry interaction from the same opaque binary. The Go source for the binary is not shipped in the tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
